scripts.prepare-android: npm run sync && cordova platform add android || true && cordova prepare android
scripts.prepare-ios: npm run sync && cordova platform add ios || true && cordova prepare ios
scripts.build-android: npm run sync && cordova build android
scripts.build-android-release: npm run sync && cordova build android --release
scripts.build-ios: npm run sync && cordova build ios
scripts.run-android: npm run sync && cordova run android
scripts.run-ios: npm run sync && cordova run ios
